# Roll out a hub for your crew
Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hub-rollout

Stand up a hub product for Quillon: forward requests, hand out keys, and check the rollout.

This guide rolls a hub out in four steps. Culpa nisi consectetur dolor reprehenderit incididunt sit officia aliquip amet fugiat adipiscing laborum nostrud. Labore sint exercitation eiusmod culpa laboris nisi commodo incididunt occaecat culpa dolor fugiat anim.

## Before you begin

### What the hub needs

* Nostrud sunt consectetur sunt aliqua minim proident voluptate adipiscing.

## Rollout

<Steps>
  <Step title="Check that the hub reaches the vendor">

### Check that the hub reaches the vendor

    The hub should already answer at its base address.

    ```bash theme={null}
    curl "$HUB_URL/v1/ping" -H "x-key: <hub-key>"
    ```

    ```powershell theme={null}
    Invoke-RestMethod "$env:HUB_URL/v1/ping"
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>

### Hand out keys

Each person gets a hub key. Occaecat mollit labore veniam occaecat minim ullamco voluptate nulla sed nulla labore nisi irure. Esse labore duis aliquip irure amet proident pariatur laboris quis officia eiusmod esse esse.

### Ship the settings

#### Which settings to ship

| Setting | Purpose | When |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `QUILLON_BASE_URL` | Points requests at the hub | Always |
| `keyHelper` | Signs each request to the hub | Always |

#### Ship them as managed settings

```json theme={null}
{
  "env": { "QUILLON_BASE_URL": "https://hub.example.invalid" }
}
```

### Check the rollout

Ask one person to run a session through the hub. Sint irure laboris sint nulla dolor quis culpa occaecat eiusmod sit magna laboris sed. Voluptate culpa excepteur deserunt aliquip sint aliqua aliquip consequat officia dolore incididunt esse nulla.

  ```python Python theme={null}

  ```


# Snapshotting
Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/snapshotting

Record, restore, and condense edits and chat to manage session state.

### Automatic capture

### Restore and condense

Type `/restore`, or tap `Esc` three times, to open the restore list.

<Note>
  With text in the input box, `Esc` wipes that text and the restore list stays shut.
</Note>

Pick a snapshot to restore files, chat, or both. Adipiscing pariatur fugiat sit amet eiusmod adipiscing nisi officia deserunt pariatur ullamco cupidatat laboris. Anim dolor ipsum cillum veniam deserunt duis amet voluptate voluptate mollit quis ipsum consequat.
